Why it exists

Problems ShiftIQ solves

Millions of lines of legacy code with no current inventory

Undocumented business rules buried in stored procedures and jobs

Complex, hidden dependencies across applications and workloads

No consistent way to score technical debt or migration risk

No defensible way to estimate effort before committing to a migration

Under the hood

How ShiftIQ analyzes your legacy code

ShiftIQ doesn't just scan file names — it parses every object into a dialect-aware abstract syntax tree, then reasons over that structure with AI models trained on legacy SQL and ETL patterns.

1

Parses SQL, stored procedures, and ETL job definitions into a dialect-aware AST

2

Cross-references every table, view, and procedure to build a live dependency graph

3

Uses AI pattern-matching to infer business rules embedded in procedural logic

4

Scores each object for complexity, risk, and technical debt using a weighted model

Capabilities

What's inside

01

Legacy code discovery

Automated inventory of applications, jobs, schemas, and code across the legacy estate.

02

AI-powered code analysis

Deep static analysis of SQL, stored procedures, and ETL logic using AI-assisted parsing.

03

Dependency analysis

Maps every dependency between tables, views, procedures, and jobs into a queryable graph.

04

Business-rule identification

Surfaces the business logic embedded in legacy code so it isn't lost in translation.

05

Data-flow analysis

Traces how data actually moves through the estate, not just how it's documented.

06

Application & workload classification

Groups applications and workloads by type, criticality, and modernization pattern.

07

Migration complexity scoring

Scores every object and application so the easiest, highest-value work can go first.

08

Technical-debt assessment

Quantifies technical debt across the estate to justify and prioritize modernization.

09

Migration-readiness assessment

Flags what's ready to migrate as-is versus what needs redesign first.

10

Source-to-target technology mapping

Maps legacy constructs to their Databricks-native equivalents ahead of conversion.

11

Migration effort estimation

Rolls complexity and readiness scores up into a defensible effort and timeline estimate.

12

Automated modernization assessment reports

Board-ready reports summarizing scope, risk, effort, and recommended sequencing.
